# Vendored styling dependencies

Self-hosted so the demo renders identically with no network. Copied
unmodified from the npm packages below; licenses travel with the files.

| Path | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| geist/Geist-Variable.woff2 | `geist@1.7.2` dist/fonts/geist-sans | SIL OFL 1.1 (geist/OFL.txt) |
| geist/GeistMono-Variable.woff2 | `geist@1.7.2` dist/fonts/geist-mono | SIL OFL 1.1 (geist/OFL.txt) |
| open-props/open-props.min.css | `open-props@1.7.16` | MIT (open-props/LICENSE) |

To add a file here, also add it to STATIC_FILES in web/server.ts; the
server only serves whitelisted paths.
